grouping_decision.reason: All four witnesses belong to the same function and the same xizi_sll/xizi_sllseg decomposition family. One worker can reuse the same unfolding, existential-instantiation, segment-composition, zero-list, and tail-value context without any cross-group helper dependency.

proof_groups.grouping_reason: The target count is four, below the controller bound of twelve, and all obligations use one single-link-list proof vocabulary. Keeping the initialization, loop-step, loop-exit, and empty-tail cases together gives one worker the full invariant lifecycle and avoids duplicated predicate setup.
proof_groups.shared_proof_pattern: For each generated top-level disjunction, select the semantically sufficient right branch. Normalize list equalities, instantiate existentials with the existing suffix/prefix variables, use xizi_sllseg_len1 plus xizi_sllseg_sllseg for the loop step, and use xizi_sll_zero plus xizi_sll_len1/xizi_sllseg_sll and xizi_sll_tail_value_app_last for returns.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove the four witnesses in manual order. Use the right disjunct of each target. The first entailment is direct existential instantiation. The second extends l1_2 by [current]. The nonempty return derives l2 = nil and rebuilds the whole list ending at current. The empty return derives l = nil from q = 0 and discharges last nil linklist_pre = linklist_pre while reconstructing or framing xizi_sll q l.

proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_entai.space_plan: Keep xizi_sll q_2 l0 unchanged and use it as xizi_sll q_2 l2 after choosing l2 = l0.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_entai.pure_plan: Simplify app nil (q :: l0) and use PreH1: l = q :: l0; reuse PreH2 and PreH3.

proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_entai.space_plan: Turn current |-> next_2 into xizi_sllseg current next_2 [current] using xizi_sllseg_len1 and PreH3, then compose it with xizi_sllseg first_2 current l1_2 using xizi_sllseg_sllseg; retain xizi_sll q l0.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_entai.pure_plan: Rewrite l2_2 by PreH1 and l by PreH2; associativity and simplification show l = (l1_2 ++ [current]) ++ next_2 :: l0. Reuse PreH4 and PreH5.

proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_retur.witness_instantiation: No post existential. Normalize next = 0 and l2 = nil, so l = l1 ++ [current].
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_retur.space_plan: Use xizi_sll_zero with PreH4 to derive l2 = nil. Convert current |-> 0 to xizi_sll current [current] by xizi_sll_len1 using PreH2 and PreH4, then compose with xizi_sllseg first current l1 using xizi_sllseg_sll to obtain xizi_sll first (l1 ++ [current]), rewritten to xizi_sll first l by PreH1.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_retur.pure_plan: After l2 = nil, PreH1 gives l = l1 ++ [current]. Apply xizi_sll_tail_value_app_last l1 current linklist_pre to obtain current = xizi_sll_tail_value l linklist_pre.

proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_retur.witness_instantiation: No post existential. Derive q = 0 and l = nil.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_retur.space_plan: Use xizi_sll_zero after PreH1 to derive l = nil. The required xizi_sll q l is the same assertion as the antecedent and may be framed; equivalently, after substituting q = 0 and l = nil it unfolds to the empty-list assertion and can be reconstructed.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetTailNode_retur.pure_plan: With l = nil, unfold xizi_sll_tail_value and simplify last nil linklist_pre to linklist_pre, proving linklist_pre = xizi_sll_tail_value l linklist_pre.

premise_discharge.xizi_sll_zero.null_root: PreH4 of return_wit_1 or PreH1 of return_wit_2
premise_discharge.xizi_sll_tail_value_app_last: Unconditional existing lemma after PreH1 and l2 = nil normalize l to l1 ++ [current]
